newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: SOCCER-CZECH REP 1 YUGOSLAVIA 2 WORLD CUP QUALIFIER - RESULT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CZECH REP 1 YUGOSLAVIA 2 WORLD CUP QUALIFIER - RESULT.

text.p: Yugoslavia beat the Czech Republic 2-1 (halftime 1-0) in their World Cup European group six qualifier on Wednesday.

Czech Republic - 1-Ludek Miklosko; 2-Radoslav Latal (14-Patrik Berger 46), 3-Tomas Repka, 4-Petr Nedved (17-Martin Frydek 83), 5-Miroslav Kadlec, 6-Michal Hornak, 7-Martin Cizek, 8-Karel Poborsky, 9-Pavel Kuka, 10-Vladimir Smicer (15-Horst Siegl 67), 11-Radek Bejbl.

Yugoslavia - 1-Ivica Kralj; 2-Zoran Mirkovic, 3-Dejan Govedarica, 4-Slavisa Jokanovic, 5-Miroslav Djukic, 6-Sinisa Mihajlovic (14-Branko Brnovic 14), 7-Vladimir Jugovic, 8-Dejan Savicevic (17-Savo Milosevic 82), 9-Predrag Mijatovic, 10-Dragan Stojkovic (15-Ljubinko Drulovic 86), 11-Albert Nadj.
